title: buddleja davidii var. nanhoensis
intro: Buddleja davidii var. nanhoensis, commonly known as Dwarf Fountain Grass or Butterfly Bush, is a compact, deciduous shrub native to China. This plant is known for its vibrant flowers and ability to attract pollinators, including butterflies and bees. The health benefits of Buddleja davidii var. nanhoensis include its potential to reduce inflammation and improve cardiovascular health due to its antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are believed to contribute to its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects.
